summary: This informational document describes a method that DHCPv6 servers can use to pick semantically opaque IPv6 interface identifiers when leasing non-temporary addresses. It is purely a server-side algorithm and needs no changes to the existing DHCPv6 specifications. The result is addresses that do not reveal information about the client.

eli5.summary: When a hotel hands out room numbers, it could follow a pattern that gives away secrets. This describes a way for the address-giving server to choose addresses that look random and reveal nothing.

questions: how to generate stable private ipv6 addresses in dhcpv6
